sloka: ततः क्रुद्धो महाबाहुर्धनुश्चिच्छेद रक्षसः।अष्टाभिरथ नाराचैः सूतं विव्याध राघवः ।। ६.७९.२९ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kruddho mahābāhurdhanuściccheda rakṣasaḥ।aṣṭābhiratha nārācaiḥ sūtaṁ vivyādha rāghavaḥ ।। 6.79.29 ।।

translations.english: Then broad shouldered Raghava was enraged and split the bow with eight steel arrows and the charioteer also.
